card.name: Patients who require or are on a regimen
card.fires_on: The word require (or on, a, special) right after patients, people or those, where a special need or restriction is about to be named. It anticipates a noun like a diet, monitoring or fluid restriction.

modes.label: Require after patients
modes.description: The verb require or requiring follows a group of people and leads into the thing they need.
modes.example: People who<< require>> continuous positive airway pressure, or CP

modes.label: On a restricted diet
modes.description: The word on or a follows patients, before a diet or restriction.
modes.example: Take sodium content into consideration in patients<< on>> a sodium-restricted diet. Avoid in

card.writes: It promotes words meaning needs or need, so it pushes the model to continue with the thing the group needs.
card.plain: It fires on words like require or on after patients, just before the text names what those patients need.
